title: Local and global well-posedness for the nonlinear Schrödinger equation with nonhomogeneous boundary conditions
summary: In this paper, we study the initial-boundary value problem for the nonlinear Schrödinger equation in $\mathbb{R}^{n}_{+}$ \begin{equation*} i\partial_{t}u+Δu+λ|u|^pu=0, \qquad (x, t) \in \mathbb{R}_{+}^{n} \times \mathbb{R}_{+},\ \ p\in\mathbb{R}_{+} \end{equation*} with nonhomogeneous Dirichlet boundary conditions. For the corresponding linear problem, endpoint Strichartz estimates are derived. For the nonlinear problem, we prove local well-posedness in $H^{s}(\mathbb{R}^{n}_{+})$ with $s\in[0,\frac{5}{2})$ and $p<\frac{4}{n-2s}$. Moreover, global well-posedness is established in the same…
